description: Speech to text with Whisper large v3 turbo: transcribe audio (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm; up to 20 MB, about 20 minutes) from a URL or base64, or translate the speech into English. Returns the text, language, duration and timed segments; optionally word-level timestamps and ready-to-use SRT or VTT subtitles (captions of at most 2 lines and 6 seconds). Costs USD 0.01 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); calls that fail are not charged.

language.description: Language code such as en or hi (detected when left out)

subtitles.description: Also return a subtitle file in this format, in subtitles

timestamps.description: word = also the start and end of every word (default segment)

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe Audio
